name: stats
description:
Returns memory system statistics. Entity/node and edge counts are tenant-wide by default. Use scope=session with session_id to scope both counts to one session.

CALL WHEN: For health monitoring, debugging, or when the user asks about memory usage.
Cost: ~5ms (runs count queries).

scope.description: tenant is the default; session scopes all counts to the supplied session_id.

session_id.description: Session UUID required when scope=session. Supplying it alone does not change the tenant-wide default.

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: metrics
description:
Returns a compact tenant-wide memory size report: total node/edge counts plus node and edge buckets, including legacy nil-session knowledge in the tenant totals.

CALL WHEN: A user asks how much knowledge is stored, how many nodes/edges memory has, or whether database-backed memory has outgrown flat files.
Cost: ~10-100ms (tenant-scoped count queries).

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: migrations
description:
Returns read-only schema migration status for the connected memory database: db_version, binary_version, pending versions, and last applied timestamp.

CALL WHEN: Startup logs or graph writes suggest schema drift, or an operator asks whether the database schema is current.
Cost: ~5ms.

name: describe
description:
Read-only, management-safe self-description of this ferrosa-memory server (contract ferrosa-memory.system.describe.v1): identity, runtime health, redacted effective config, dependent-store health, live ferrosa cluster info (queried from the CQL system tables), summary memory statistics, schema drift, binary/release state, capabilities, and allowed management actions.

CALL WHEN: A management client (e.g. Ferrosa Workbench) discovers or is pointed at this endpoint and needs the authoritative cluster descriptor instead of inferring it from local files. Secrets are never returned; their key paths appear under configuration.redactedKeys.
Cost: ~10-3000ms (bounded dependency probes).

caller.description: Optional calling client identity, logged for diagnostics.

include.description: Optional list of sections to return. Omit for all sections.

redaction.description: Redaction mode. Only management-safe is supported; secrets are always redacted.

session_id.description: Session to scope the statistics section to (defaults to the nil session).

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: forget
description:
Candidate-confirmed forgetting, in two phases. PROPOSE (pass `query`, no token): searches memory across sessions for candidates matching the intent, returns each candidate's blast radius (edges/temporal/derived it references) plus a signed `forget_token` — mutates nothing. CONFIRM (pass `forget_token` + `selected_ids` + `confirm: true`): forgets only the approved ids. Defaults to reversible RETRACT (excluded from recall, audited, restorable via restore_forgotten for `retract_purge_days`); pass `mode: "hard"` for permanent deletion. Never forgets without explicit confirmation; skips any candidate that changed since proposal.

CALL WHEN: the user asks to forget/remove specific memories. Always propose first, show the candidates, and only confirm the ids the user approves — never pass confirm:true on the user's behalf.
Cost: propose ~20ms + search; confirm ~10-50ms per item.

acknowledge_high_impact.description: Required to forget a high-impact (highly-connected) candidate.

confirm.description: Must be true (with forget_token) to execute the forget.

forget_token.description: Confirm phase: the token returned by a prior propose call.

query.description: Propose phase: natural-language description of what to forget.

selected_ids.description: Confirm phase: the candidate ids the user approved.

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: restore
description:
Reverse a retraction: restore a soft-forgotten entity to its prior memory state so it is recalled again. Works only for retract-mode forgets that have not yet been purged (within retract_purge_days); hard deletes are irreversible. Note: edges removed at forget time are not auto-recreated in v1.

CALL WHEN: the user wants to undo a forget / bring back a retracted memory.
Cost: ~10ms.

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: type_counts
description:
Return an entity histogram broken down by entity_type, by state, and by the joint (type,state) buckets. Counts are tenant-wide by default. Use scope=session with session_id to scope the histogram to one session.

CALL WHEN: You need status/diagnostic counts like 'how many bugs are active in this session?' without coupling the client to entity_store columns.
Cost: ~5-10ms.

scope.description: tenant is the default; session scopes the histogram to the supplied session_id.

session_id.description: Session UUID required when scope=session. Supplying it alone does not change the tenant-wide default.
